category: Polish multi-hoster debrid, prepaid traffic packages

free_tier.stated: None. The site sells traffic packages only, from 10 GB at 6,99 zł; no trial, credit or free plan is offered on the home page or the price page.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated: the product is a traffic balance, capped by total gigabytes rather than by file size

retention.stated: Purchased transfer does not expire: 'Transfer nie wygasa' on every package.

egress.terms: Prepaid gigabytes, no expiry, no speed cap: 'Bez limitu prędkości', 'Transfer nie wygasa'.
egress.price_per_tb: PLN 31.99 per 100 GB (PLN 0.32/GB); PLN 109.99 per 400 GB (PLN 0.27/GB)

interface_detail: Web form: paste a link, the service fetches it, the client downloads from its servers. No API, CLI or protocol endpoint is documented.
tooling: Browser only as far as the site documents; no API and no download-manager plugin is named.
chaining: At PLN 0.27-0.70 per GB it is the cheapest option for a few tens of gigabytes once, and the worst option for a sustained daily load; it belongs in the overflow slot, not the base of the stack.
limits_note: 64 supported hostings. No concurrency figure, no per-host daily cap and no fair-use paragraph is published.
binding_note: The balance runs out mid-transfer rather than the speed or the request rate.

identity_cost.detail: An account is needed to hold the prepaid balance; the signup form was not opened, and login is protected by a Cloudflare Turnstile widget.

reliability_note: Prepaid credit with no expiry is the safe shape for a service that might close: the risk is losing an unused balance, not a subscription charge. The brand's own HTML is a clone of a second brand (see notes).
confidence_note: The full price ladder, the host count and the no-expiry term are vendor-stated and read. What would raise it: buying 100 GB and pulling 100 GB, which would also show whether the 64 hosts all resolve.

evidence.proved: the six package prices from 10 GB / 6,99 zł to 400 GB / 109,99 zł, 'Pobieranie z 64 hostingów', 'Transfer nie wygasa'
the three-step flow, 'Jedno konto - kilkadziesiąt hostingów' and the supported-host list headed by Filefactory, Turbobit and Youtube

the two home pages are the same build: after normalising the brand string the raw HTML differs only in the GA property, the logo asset, the Trustpilot business-unit id and the Turnstile site key, and both carry the same Google Ads conversion id AW-17061610643

price_per_tb_month: PLN 276 per TB (EUR 63.2 at the ECB reference rate 4.3695 of 2026-10-22)
notes: White-label twin of RapidTraffic.pl: two domains, one codebase, one Google Ads conversion id, one price list. Treat the two as one provider and do not count them as two services. At a user's volume the pay-per-GB model is 20 times the monthly cost of AllDebrid, so this is a small-burst tool, not a base.
